scope.note: All nine current MRes programmes are listed by UNNC as full-time research degrees. Sustainable Energy and Building Technologies also has a part-time mode, but this Korean international-student guide focuses on full-time study.

global_requirements.academic: Normally UK honours bachelor degree at 2:1 or international equivalent in a relevant subject; programme-specific subject requirements apply.

research_proposal.note: Proposal is assessed for content and format. Applicants are recommended to discuss it with a potential supervisor before submission.

english.IELTS: 6.0 overall, no less than 5.5 in each element
english.note: Current live course pages for the nine FoSE MRes programmes use IELTS 6.0 / 5.5. Programme-specific pages remain the controlling source.

september.note: September 2027 self-funded deadline has not yet been published. The Graduate School advises applying at least three months before the desired registration date.

tuition.note: Graduate School states fees are subject to change.

scholarships_2027.note: The current PGR fees and scholarships page lists PhD scholarships but does not confirm a 2027 MRes-specific scholarship. Do not apply Postgraduate Taught global scholarship rules to MRes without a current official MRes source.

programmes.name: Chemical Engineering and Technology
programmes.background_summary: Engineering or Science background at UK 2:1 equivalent or above; relevant subject fit is assessed.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Chemical engineering research, advanced process and technology development.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.background_summary: Minimum UK 2:1 equivalent; relevant engineering background and research fit are important.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Smart grid, electric drives, power electronics, renewable energy, storage, control, EVs and AI in electrical engineering.

programmes.name: Electronic Engineering
programmes.background_summary: Minimum UK 2:1 equivalent; relevant engineering background and research fit are important.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Robotics, automation, signal processing, VLSI, telecommunications, sensing and related electronic systems research.

programmes.name: Environmental Science and Engineering
programmes.faculty_unit: Geographical Sciences / Chemical and Environmental Engineering
programmes.background_summary: Bachelor of Engineering or Science at UK 2:1 equivalent or above. Relevant disciplines include Environmental Science, Geographical Sciences, Chemical Engineering and Environmental Engineering.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Experimental and modelling research in environmental science, environmental management and engineering systems.

programmes.name: Innovative Product Design and Manufacture
programmes.background_summary: Bachelor of Engineering or Science at UK 2:1 equivalent or above. Relevant disciplines include Product Design and Manufacture, Manufacturing Engineering, Human Factors and Human-Computer Interaction.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Multidisciplinary design research and innovative product/manufacturing solutions.

programmes.name: Materials Science and Engineering
programmes.background_summary: Engineering or Science background at UK 2:1 equivalent or above; relevant materials/manufacturing subject fit is assessed.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Advanced materials, manufacturing, structures and related materials engineering research.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.background_summary: Bachelor of Engineering or Science at UK 2:1 equivalent or above. Relevant disciplines include Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials, Aeronautical and Chemical Engineering.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Mechanical, materials and manufacturing engineering research with advanced technical and professional research training.

programmes.name: Smart Construction
programmes.background_summary: Minimum UK 2:1 equivalent; relevant civil engineering/construction research fit is important.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Smart construction, GIS/information modelling, advanced surveying, structures, transport, geotechnics, construction management and data analysis.

programmes.name: Sustainable Energy and Building Technologies
programmes.faculty_unit: Chemical and Environmental Engineering / Architecture and Built Environment
programmes.background_summary: Bachelor of Engineering or Science at UK 2:1 equivalent or above. Relevant engineering/science background is required.
programmes.research_theme_summary: Energy, architecture, environmental systems and sustainable building technologies research.
